_note: Voice chat (src/net/voice.ts). Push to talk (the `voice` key, Caps Lock by default), peer to peer between the players who may hear each other: your squad in a battle royale, your team in the team modes, everyone otherwise. volume is how loud a voice plays (0 to 1; the Settings tab changes it). levelHold is how much of a voice's loudness the talking mark keeps from one frame to the next, so a word is one mark and not a flicker; talking is the loudness (0 to 1) over which a player shows as talking. Ours.
_retry: a call to a squad mate that was turned away or lost (their page not ready for it yet, or not yet told we are in its group) is made again after ms, then twice that, up to times, while they are still in the group and the microphone is on (Milestone 735: made once, they never heard us until the group changed). Ours.
